title: Fed Chair Warsh signals possible rate hike at Jackson Hole, says inflation still too high
summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said at the Jackson Hole symposium that inflation remains above the 2% target and the Fed has 'work to do,' signaling potential rate increases. The 2-year Treasury yield jumped over 6 basis points to 4.298%, and market odds of a September rate hike rose to 46%.
why: 新任美联储主席Warsh首次杰克逊霍尔讲话显著鹰派，加息预期回升将压制估值并抬升期权隐含波动率；卖put策略需重新评估各标的行权价安全边际。

title: Gold drops over 1% as Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole remarks lift rate-hike bets
summary: Gold fell more than 1% on Friday after Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish speech at Jackson Hole drove rate-hike expectations higher. Comex December gold fell as much as 3.2% to $4,515 per ounce, with spot gold at approximately $4,454, down 3.18% on the day.
why: 金价大跌直接利空老铺黄金（6181.HK）等黄金相关标的；加息预期上升同时令成长股估值承压，需评估相关持仓的sell put行权价保护空间。

title: U.S. Treasury launches 'Operation Economic Outcast' against Iran, targeting crypto, gold, aviation
summary: The U.S. Treasury sanctioned nearly 60 Iran-linked targets on August 24 in a campaign dubbed 'Operation Economic Outcast,' designating digital assets as a sanctionable sector under EO 13902 and adding crypto wallet addresses across Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tron networks. Bitcoin surged past $80,000 on the news.
why: 稳定币/加密基础设施受地缘政策直接影响；Bitcoin超$80K有利于Circle（USDC流通量）；同时该制裁行动推升油价预期，间接影响通胀路径。延续报道：制裁实施和市场余震仍在持续。

title: Meituan snaps losing streak with profitable June quarter though Douyin threat looms
summary: Meituan (3690.HK) reported Q2 2026 revenue of RMB 104.6 billion (+14.4% YoY), with adjusted net profit of RMB 2.16 billion, reversing a RMB 4.97 billion loss in Q1. Keeta turned profitable in Saudi Arabia within 22 months of entry. The company holds a RMB 168.3 billion cash position.
why: 美团Q2扭亏且Keeta海外盈利是重要里程碑；外卖价格战趋缓改善利润能见度；高现金储备可支撑股东回报，对sell put策略有支撑；但抖音竞争威胁仍是长期风险。

title: Tencent (00700) repurchased 670,000 shares for HK$301 million on August 27
summary: Tencent Holdings (0700.HK) bought back 670,000 shares for approximately HK$301 million on August 27, 2026, per HKEX filing. The company has repurchased 40.1 million shares under the current authorization allowing up to 911.8 million shares.
why: 腾讯持续每日回购（约HK$3亿/次）是底部支撑信号，累计回购4010万股；对持有0700.HK的sell put仓位有价格支撑作用，但属常规操作，仅供参考。
